title: 列表从记录「↗」打开时条件出现两遍：上面一个带记录名的标签，下面又一个锁定条件「Account: = <原始 id>」和第二个「重置」
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZiaBg6rk7dpy1s9Me

Filing gate: ① a measured defect under list epic #35547, sub-card of #35549 (filter conditions as tags). Filed by area ux-3 on seat 5's ask; suggested grade p1, because it shows on every list opened with a URL condition (every 「↗ 在列表中打开」 from a record's related tab). ⛔ Not a claim on its own; the claim follows.

## Seen (showcase, 1280×800; screenshot from ux-2's run on #35601: `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat5/area-ux/ux-2/a4-35601/06-open-list-sourced.png`)

Open an account (Globex), go to its Contacts tab, press 「↗」. The Contacts list opens filtered to that account and shows the same condition twice:

1. The page's row: 「Filtered by · Account Globex ×」 with a 「Reset」 on the right.
2. Under the toolbar, the list's own condition row: a locked chip 「🔒 Account: = 3zKQep1xNgNHlrBO」 (the raw record id), 「+ Add filter」, and a second 「Reset」.

Cause, by reading `origin/main`: the data page (`ObjectDataPage.tsx`) draws its URL conditions as its own tags AND passes them to the list as the view's filter (`schema.filter`). The list (`ListConditionControls.tsx`, `ConditionChipRow`) draws every view-filter condition as a locked chip, with the comparand as written (a lookup's id, never its name).

## Done when

- A list opened with URL conditions shows each condition once, as one tag carrying the record's name, and one 「Reset」.
- Where the list does draw a locked chip for a lookup condition (a saved view filtered on a lookup), the chip shows the record's name, not its id.
- The list's own 「+ Add filter」 and user-condition chips still work beside the page's tags; removing a page tag still clears that condition.
- Pinned at the list (one tag per condition, name not id) and at the data page's sourced open; zh-CN and en.

Dedupe: issue search `locked chip raw id`, `Filtered by duplicate chip`, `view-condition-chip lookup name`, `open in list condition tag` → only #35601 (ux-2's related tab, which draws the source tag; this card is the list side).
